description: The SASS ptxas makes for the evict-first GEMM's hinted 8-byte K-tail cp.async, which GB10 rejects (Xid 13, Illegal Instruction Parameter): the TP4 down GEMM compiled with the hint on the tail, without a hint, and with the hint on the scale codes only, and the standalone 8-byte hinted kernel that runs; each one's LDGSTS instructions from cuobjdump -sass. Compiles only; no GEMM is launched.
